thesis: Force of Will became the safety valve of Vintage and Legacy by allowing blue decks to interact before mana development, exchanging a card and one life for the right to prevent otherwise decisive early plays.

canonicalIdentity.currentOracleText: You may pay 1 life and exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost. Counter target spell.
